scope: Only named foreign retailers with official evidence they deliver to the Netherlands. Shipping is never final until confirmed for the selected product and basket.
pricingRule: Compare identical size/SKU on item price + shipping to NL + destination VAT + customs/duties + handling. Never label tariff estimates as all-in verified checkout totals.

internationalOutsideEU.note: A shop saying 'ships worldwide' is insufficient. Calculate currency FX, NL VAT, import duty, carrier handling, shipping and returns. Customs exemptions/tariffs depend on current rules, goods and dispatch country.
